description: Per-field verdicts for Prisma Float columns whose NAME matches the money heuristic in check-policy.mjs but whose MEANING is a dimensionless metric. ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW § F11 / R11.
rules: A Float column matching the money heuristic is a violation unless it is listed here as 'metric' with a reason. Fail-closed: an unlisted field is always a violation, so a new Float money column is still caught.

'metric' means the value is a ratio, count, duration, or physical measurement — never a currency amount, and never multiplied by one. A rate that multiplies money (tax, discount, interest) is NOT a metric: float drift in the rate becomes float drift in the money. Those were converted to Decimal(9,6).
Adding an entry is a schema-design decision and needs the same review as a migration. Do not add one to make the gate pass.

metrics.reason: The value of a named ML metric — accuracy, precision, recall, f1 or latency, per the sibling `metric` discriminator. Dimensionless.
A computed KPI trend reading. Presentation-layer analytics recomputed from source records; never the source of a posting.
Prior-period counterpart of AnalyticsTrendResult.value; same treatment.
App Studio usage telemetry (views, edits, publishes). A count, not an amount.
Statistical process control centre line — a physical measurement in the chart's own unit, not currency.
A single SPC measurement against the chart above. Same unit, same treatment.
Share of form sessions that reached submission. Dimensionless ratio.
On-time-in-full delivery ratio. A service-level metric.
Share of deliveries arriving on time. Service-level metric.
Share of deliveries arriving complete. Service-level metric.
Share of shipments damaged. Service-level metric.
Share of shipments generating a claim. Service-level metric; the claim's own value is a separate Decimal column.
Supply-chain scorecard counterpart of the logistics metric above.
Share of demand met from stock. Dimensionless ratio.
Share of orders with no defect of any kind. Dimensionless ratio.
Share of units returned. Dimensionless ratio; refund amounts are Decimal elsewhere.
Transport cost as a percentage of revenue — a reported ratio derived from two Decimal columns, not an input to any posting.
Subjective scorecard rating. Dimensionless.
Duration in hours. Matched the heuristic on 'total' only; hours are not currency.
Units produced in the period. A count; matched on 'total'.
Share of output scrapped. Dimensionless ratio.
Share of output reworked. Dimensionless ratio.

converted.reason: A currency variance against contracted cost.
A currency amount per unit produced.
Multiplies a customs value to produce duty payable — float drift in the rate becomes float drift in money owed.
Multiplies a taxable base to produce VAT payable. Statutory amount; must be exact.
Multiplies an invoice line to produce the discount amount.
Multiplies a principal to produce interest payable.
Joint-cost allocation factor: multiplies total production cost to split it across co-products, so drift in the factor is drift in allocated cost.
